(April 24th, May 13th) In the Senior Javelin, Veronica St Ange took the bronze medal with 33.60 and Suzanne Jordan ran 5 21.3 for 1500m in the Junior Ladies event.
Wendy Dunsford and Veronica St Ange were the basis of our throwing squad backed by Julie Jones who has also developed into an excellent sprinter.
However a Club record in the javelin by Veronica St Ange and some personal best performances prevented this happening but we dropped down to 6th position in the League.

Wendy Dunsford represented Middlesex in a meeting in May held at Motspur Park, whilst Veronica St. Ange competed for Surrey in a representative match in July at Copthall and Rosemary Honeychurch represented Surrey in the Southern Womens Inter Counties Championships in August held at Crystal Palace.

Our Turkish national champion Perrican Bayar improved the Discus record by over 9 metres, Veronica St. Ange broke the Javelin record and Andrea Coore broke the Inters High Jump record and equalled the Senior record.

In the London Borough Championships Heats Veronica St.Ange won the javelin with 41.52, Jessica Palma was 2nd in the 200m with 28.0 and Rosemary Honeychurch won the 1500m with 4:46.2, while Yvette Edwards ran a 13.1 100m.
